description: Calendar-first minimalist launcher: your agenda, and traces left for later. Entropy's Defiance is a minimalist Android launcher built around your calendar. The home screen is your agenda: today, then the days ahead, straight from the calendars you already keep. There is no separate task database, so everything syncs wherever your calendar syncs: DAVx5 or any CalDAV server, Google, or a local calendar. Next to your events live your traces: anything you take out of your head to keep — a task, an idea, a note, something not to forget. Traces live in one calendar of your choosing, whatever it is called. Leave one with + and a horizon — Today, This Week, This Month, This Year or This Life — meaning "not relevant before then", and it stays out of sight until its day comes. A trace left undone is carried onto today and marked in red, until you move it or mark it done. Features * Home screen agenda with "in 20 min" and "10 min left" hints and a progress line for what is under way * Traces shown with a ring and kept together within each day, events with a bar * Swipe an entry right to move it: +1h, +1d, +1w, next free slot, today, or a later horizon * Long-press for Done and Edit, plus Focus and Navigate where they apply * Long-press the date for a list of all traces by horizon * Focus: Do Not Disturb until an event ends, restoring your previous setting * Every change can be undone for a few seconds before it is written * App drawer with your most-used apps first and instant search; hide and rename apps * Accent colour from Material You, a preset, or your own; left-handed mode; fullscreen; adjustable wallpaper dim * Upgrading from 3.x: open tasks from the old task file can be brought into your trace calendar Permissions * Query all packages — needed to list installed apps in the drawer * Read and write calendar — to show your events and traces and change them when you ask * Do Not Disturb access — only used for Focus, granted in system settings * Exact alarms — to end Focus on time * Set wallpaper — used by the launcher to restore your wallpaper * Request package deletion — lets the drawer's Uninstall open the system dialog The app is offline, has no internet permission, and contains no trackers, no analytics, and no ads. Source code is published under the Mozilla Public License 2.0 at https://gitlab.com/hwanderer/entropysdefiance. If you'd like to support development: https://buymeacoffee.com/hwanderer
